title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Quick answers about ordering, our branches, and how to reach Vkusno. For addresses, maps, and opening hours, see the Contact page.

items.question: How do I order from Vkusno?
items.answer: Open our Menu, choose the dish you want, and tap Order. Pick the kitchen closest to you, then select a delivery app shown for that branch. You complete payment and delivery through that app-not on vkusno.ae.

items.question: Can I order directly from Vkusno?
items.answer: Yes! In the Menu order flow, use Order directly to order online via RestHero, call us, or WhatsApp. Even phone orders are placed through the RestHero platform so your order reaches our kitchen directly.

items.question: How far does direct delivery from Arjan reach?
items.answer: Direct delivery from our Arjan kitchen covers roughly 30 km (delivered via RestHero using Careem or Slider riders). During peak hours the radius may be slightly reduced. For areas outside that range, choose another branch or a delivery app that serves your area.

items.question: Can I order directly on vkusno.ae?
items.answer: For Arjan, yes - use Order from us in the Menu order modal to reach our RestHero ordering page. Other branches use partner apps such as Talabat, Careem, Deliveroo, Noon, or Keeta. Our site helps you explore the menu and pick the right kitchen.

items.question: Which delivery apps do you use?
items.answer: We work with leading platforms in the UAE, including Talabat, Careem, Deliveroo, Noon, and Keeta. The apps available depend on the branch you select in our order flow.

items.question: Are the same apps available at every branch?
items.answer: No. Each kitchen may offer a different set of delivery partners-but together our branches and aggregators cover all areas of Dubai. After you pick a branch on the Menu order screen, we show the apps linked to that location. Choose the kitchen nearest you or the app you prefer.

items.question: Can I pick up my order instead of delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Pickup is available at all listed Vkusno locations. Order through the delivery app that serves your chosen branch and select pickup if the app offers it, or contact the branch directly for guidance.

items.question: How many Vkusno locations are there?
items.answer: We operate five kitchens across Dubai: Arjan, Dubai Marina, Business Bay (SOL Avenue), Business Bay (Cuisinette), and Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO). Full addresses and map pins are on our Contact page.

items.question: Are all branches open 24/7?
items.answer: Not all. Several locations run 24/7, while others open daily from 07:00 to 23:00. Check the branch list or map on the Contact page for the latest hours for each kitchen.

items.question: How do I find the branch nearest to me?
items.answer: Use the interactive map on our Contact page to compare locations, or open the Menu order flow and choose the kitchen that is most convenient for you. Each branch card includes a Directions link to Google Maps.

items.question: Do you offer dine-in?
items.answer: Selected locations offer casual self-service seating for customers who order at the counter. We do not provide full table service. If you plan to eat on site, contact the branch ahead or ask staff when you arrive.

items.question: Is there parking at your branches?
items.answer: Parking varies by location and surrounding building rules. We recommend using the Directions link on the Contact page and checking signage or reception at the building where the kitchen is located.

items.question: What kind of food does Vkusno serve?
items.answer: Vkusno serves home-style Russian comfort food-hearty soups, dumplings, grilled dishes, salads, and familiar classics rooted in family recipes and Russia’s culinary heritage.

items.question: Is the menu the same at every branch?
items.answer: Our website shows Vkusno’s full menu. At some branches, individual items may be temporarily unavailable. For the most up-to-date availability, check the menu on your delivery aggregator when you place an order.

items.question: Do you accommodate dietary requirements or allergies?
items.answer: If you have allergies, intolerances, or specific dietary needs, contact us before ordering. Share details when you call, WhatsApp, or message the branch so our team can advise you on suitable dishes.

items.question: How can I contact Vkusno?
items.answer: Call or WhatsApp us at +971 52 102 5674, or email info@vkusno.ae. You can also use the Contact page for branch details, social links, and the location map.
